summary: Backend and Android implementation are correct and consistent with the plan; two deployment prerequisites (Gmail App Password, USE_LOCAL flag) and one low-severity HTML-injection in the admin email are flagged but do not block shipping.
findings: EMAIL_PASSWORD in .env is still the placeholder 'your_app_password_here' — no email will deliver until a real Gmail App Password is set; with no database persistence, a delivery failure means the request is permanently lost.
ApiClient.USE_LOCAL = true hardcodes the emulator URL (http://10.0.2.2:8000); must be switched to USE_LOCAL = false with a correct PRODUCTION_URL before distributing the app.

subject, description, category, and orderNumber are interpolated raw into the admin HTML email without HTML-escaping; a user can inject HTML that renders in the operator's email client — add a minimal escape helper on all four fields.
